heading: INT. ROLLER DERBY RINK, LOCKER ROOM - EVENING

units.text: INT. ROLLER DERBY RINK, LOCKER ROOM - EVENING
Rows of dented lockers.
Skates on benches like sleeping animals.
A banner on the wall: THE IRON MAIDENS OF MERIDIAN.
The air smells of liniment and nerves.
BRYNHILDE "BRUISER" OKONKWO-LARSSON (30s, shoulders like a door, face paint half-applied) laces her skates with ferocious focus.
Beside her, rookie JOSEFINA ABERNATHY-SILVA (19, stiff new helmet, wide eyes) copies every move.
Across the room, coach HORTENSIA "HORTY" BELLAMY-OKORO (50s, whistle, tracksuit) leans against a locker with a clipboard.
Ladies. Last bout of the season.
units.name: HORTY

units.text: We know.
units.name: BRUISER

units.text: Josefina, this is your first jam.
units.name: HORTY

units.text: I know.
units.name: JOSEFINA

units.text: You'll be nervous.
units.name: HORTY

units.text: I'm not nervous.
units.name: JOSEFINA

units.text: She's nervous.
units.name: BRUISER

units.text: Good. Nerves keep you alive.
units.name: HORTY

units.text: She blows the whistle once, softly, as a kind of benediction.
Bruiser stands, rolling her neck.
Come on, kid. Stay on my hip.
units.name: BRUISER

units.text: Where's your hip?
units.name: JOSEFINA

units.text: Wherever it is when you need it.
units.name: BRUISER

units.text: They stack fists.
The crowd roars outside.
A door bangs.
The three women walk out together into a tunnel of light.
